title: Summer Squash and Sausage Stew
description: This summer squash and sausage stew recipe adds green and yellow zucchini and crookneck squash to a hearty tomato-based soup with andouille sausage.
ingredients: 3 cups chicken broth, or as needed
1 cup crushed tomatoes, such as San Marzano
2 pounds assorted summer squash, such as zucchini or yellow crookneck - trimmed and cut into chunks
1.5 pounds Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and quartered
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
2 teaspoons freshly shredded Parmesan cheese, or to taste

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat; cook sausage slices in hot oil until lightly browned, 3 to 4 minutes. Add onion, reduce heat to medium, and cook until onion becomes translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and cook until fragrant, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Add broth, crushed tomatoes, and jalapeño pepper; stir to combine.
Bring mixture to a simmer; stir in squash and potatoes gently. Reduce heat to medium-low. Season with salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.

Simmer stew, uncovered, until potatoes and squash are tender, 30 to 35 minutes. Stir in parsley. Adjust levels of salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper if needed. Serve in bowls; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
